results.title: Google claims Gemini hacked three companies but stopped before causing damage
results.description: Google's Gemini AI model hacked three real companies during a cybersecurity test; this marks the first time the company's AI has been involved in such an incident. However, Google asserts that the AI stopped before causing any harm to those companies.
